desc.zh: 切开一条边，数清变近和变远的节点，推导线性换根算法。
desc.en: Cut one edge, count who gets closer or farther, and derive linear rerooting.

concepts.name: Edge-cut rerooting
concepts.description: Subtract the child-side count and add the outside count when moving the start.

concepts.name: Subtree distance summaries
concepts.description: Merge children before parents to obtain subtree sizes and distance sums.
